help.click: Click land next to yours to expand, or a neighbour's land to attack

hud.cityHint: City (C): raises your troop cap. Then click your land.
hud.palaceHint: Micho Palace (B): two cities in one, for the price of your next two. Then click your land.
hud.portHint: Port (O): trade ships sail from it to other players' ports and pay both sides. Then click your coast.
hud.warshipHint: Warship (V): click your port to buy one, then water to send your closest warship to patrol there. It fires on ships of players at war with you.
hud.siloHint: Missile silo (L): launches missiles, one at a time with a reload. Then click your land.
hud.airDefenseHint: Air defense (K): may stop enemy missiles flying near it. Then click your land.
hud.missileHint: Missile (M): from your closest loaded silo, wipes out land, troops and structures where it strikes. Then click the target.
hud.heavyMissileHint: Heavy missile (N): a wider blast, and the land stays unusable for a minute. Then click the target.
hud.fortHint: Fort (F): nearby land costs twice as much to take. Then click your land.
hud.demolishHint: Demolish (X): remove one of your structures, with no refund.
hud.modeCity: Click your land to build a city. Esc to cancel.

hud.modePort: Click by the water, near your land: the port goes on your closest coast. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeWarship: Click your port to buy a warship, or water to patrol there. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeSilo: Click your land to build a missile silo. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeAirDefense: Click your land to build an air defense. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeMissile: Click where the missile should strike. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeHeavyMissile: Click where the heavy missile should strike. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeFort: Click your land to build a fort. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeDemolish: Click one of your structures to demolish it. Esc to cancel.

help.tap: Tap land next to yours to expand, or a neighbour's land to attack
help.shipsTouch: Tap a coast across the sea to send a ship
help.ratioTouch: The slider at the bottom sets the share of your troops each attack takes
help.diplomacyTouch: Long press a country, or tap a row of the leaderboard: alliances, embargoes, gifts and messages

help.buildHow: Gold comes in by itself. Pick a building with its button, its key or its number (1 to 9), then click where it goes: a preview shows whether it fits and what it costs; each one costs more than the last.
help.buildHowTouch: Gold comes in by itself. Tap a building's button, then tap where it goes: the first tap shows a preview, the second places it; each one costs more than the last.
help.place.city: Raises your troop cap · on your land, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.palace: Worth two cities, for the price of your next two · on your land, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.fort: Your land around it costs twice as much to take · on your land, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.port: Trades with other players' ports · on your coast, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.silo: Launches missiles · on your land, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.airDefense: May stop missiles flying near it · on your land, {spacing} tiles from any other building
help.place.warship: Fires on ships of players at war with you · bought at one of your ports, then sent by a click on water
help.place.missile: Wipes out what it hits · needs a loaded silo, then any target
help.place.heavyMissile: A wider blast, and the land stays unusable for a minute · needs a loaded silo
help.place.demolish: Removes one of your buildings, with no refund
guide.title: First steps {step}/{count}
guide.start: Click any land to choose where you start. You can move it until the countdown ends.
guide.startTouch: Tap any land to choose where you start. You can move it until the countdown ends.
guide.expand: Click land next to yours to expand into it. The slider at the bottom, or Shift + 1 to 0, sets how many troops go.
guide.expandTouch: Tap land next to yours to expand into it. The slider at the bottom sets how many troops go.
guide.build: Gold comes in by itself. Once you have {cost}, press City (C) and click your land: a city raises your troop cap.
guide.buildTouch: Gold comes in by itself. Once you have {cost}, tap City, the diamond, then your land: a city raises your troop cap.
guide.players: Right click a country, or click a name in the leaderboard, to ask for an alliance, send a gift or a message.
guide.playersTouch: Long press a country, or tap a name in the leaderboard, to ask for an alliance, send a gift or a message.
guide.done: You know the basics. H or ? shows every control, with the cost of each building.
guide.doneTouch: You know the basics. The ? button shows every gesture, with the cost of each building.
guide.attack: Troops you send leave home; the ones you keep earn gold and defend your land. Shift + 1 to 0 pick the share. A running attack has a Retreat button.
guide.attackTouch: Troops you send leave home; the ones you keep earn gold and defend your land. The slider picks the share. A running attack has a Retreat button.
guide.defend: Neighbours attack too. Land held by many troops is dear to take, and a Fort (F) doubles the price of the land around it: press F, then click your border.
guide.defendTouch: Neighbours attack too. Land held by many troops is dear to take, and a Fort doubles the price of the land around it: tap Fort, then your border.
help.defendTroops: The more troops you keep per tile, the dearer your land is to take: do not send everything
help.defendFort: A fort doubles the price of the land around it: build it behind a border that is attacked
help.defendRetreat: Retreat on a running attack calls its troops back, minus a share lost on the way
help.defendCapital: Capital mode: the crown is your capital. Whoever takes it takes your whole empire, so keep fronts away from it and build forts around it
help.holdTouch: Long press a building button to read what it does
online.joinHint: You were invited to an online game. Pick the name the other players will see.
